status: Read-only analysis. No pinned artifact of any other package is modified; the two files below are vendored verbatim and are verified by sha256 on every run of beats.py.

pins.role: The supplier's exact interval and exponential enclosures (PR200's own arithmetic). Every number in beats.json is computed with this module; no floating point enters a check.
pins.upstream: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds, PR200 (research package) references/intervals used by bit/prove.py
pins.license: as published in the upstream repository

pins.role: The frontier certificate: the two side child ledgers (bit_profile, complex_profile), the two published side savings (a_bit, a_complex), the published kappa and the assembly status. It is the object this package reproduces and prices against.
pins.upstream: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds, queue snapshot 2026-10-09, PR207 coordinated crossover
pins.license: as published in the upstream repository

pins.role: The supplier's published finite bank proof for the physical bit word: the projector partition that fills a width-72 bank, the universal disjoint-projector algebra, the 144 two-bank address-map columns over F2 and Z, the exact removed exterior set (the 2,200 rank-60 gauges), the resulting stock/mass/deficit, and the conditional interfaces it does not discharge. instantiate.py reads this proof item by item against the rank-6 rung.
pins.upstream: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds, research/coordinated-frames-and-entrance-banks/BANK-PROOF.md (PR186 lineage, as carried into PR205/PR206/PR207)
pins.license: as published in the upstream repository

method_provenance.assembly_rule: kappa = floor(min(a_bit, a_complex)/(1 + min(...))) on the certificate's own 10^-16 grid, discovered by search in beats.py rather than assumed
method_provenance.saving_rule: the largest 10^-18 grid point whose paid moment pays; the certificate prices its bit side with PR200's rare-class fallback term and its complex side without it, and each is reproduced exactly under its own convention
method_provenance.bank_rule: a family is bankable when its own blocks tile a width-m bank (m % rank == 0) and its own volume is a whole number of banks; the wider screen keeps only the volume condition, which is what the queue's certified banked rows satisfy
method_provenance.signed_roots: the contraction and bank models, their validation against the queue's published banked rows, and the closed-form bank proof are PR184/PR185/PR197/PR200/PR205/PR206/PR207's, as carried in the supplier's package; this package re-implements only the arithmetic it prices with
method_provenance.instantiation_read: instantiate.py derives the block/bank schedule of a candidate absorption from the certificate's own histogram and maps it onto the items of the vendored bank proof; it builds no bank, chart or witness

local_environment: Windows checkout of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds (branch ordered-chain-h23), Python 3.14, beats.py run from the repository root
